To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) data scientists use a variety of statistical descriptors and visualizations to explore their data, and (2) Foresight is a visualization recommender for rapid EDA that helps users explore the space of guideposts, a network of visualizations corresponding to prominent instances of the statistical descriptors.

Foresight is a visualization recommender tool that enables interactive exploration of large-scale, complex datasets through guideposts, which are visualizations corresponding to pronounced instances of statistical descriptors.
Foresight is an interactive tool that facilitates rapid exploratory data analysis of large datasets by helping users explore the network of data guideposts.

how visualization systems can help the user to rapidly navigate large datasets and identify interesting data patterns.
the design of tools to help the user rapidly and effectively explore large datasets.

Foresight is a visualization recommender that facilitates rapid data exploration of large datasets by providing the user with a network of visualizations that are ranked based on a statistical descriptor of interest.
Foresight is an interactive visualization recommender that enables rapid exploration of large, high-dimensional datasets.
we introduce a new visualization recommender system to support rapid exploratory data analysis of large, high-dimensional datasets.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
Foresight provides a framework for interactive exploration through guideposts, a new paradigm for exploratory data visualization.

we present an approach that allows for a rapid and thorough exploration of large datasets by providing a set of guideposts to the user, and allowing the user to navigate the space of guideposts using a set of guidepost queries.
Foresight helps users rapidly explore large datasets by providing a set of guideposts, which are visualizations corresponding to the strongest instances of statistical descriptors.
The main takeaway from our work is that
EDA is a complex, multi-step process with multiple goals and that the design of tools should reflect these complexities.
Foresight can help users explore large datasets by reducing the complexity of the exploration space to the set of guideposts.

, for EDA tasks, data scientists prefer a system that can rapidly generate and rank a wide range of statistical descriptors of their data, rather than having to manually choose a small set of statistical descriptors and visual encodings.
